findings.what: Nothing tells a cautious saver which track is the safe one or how it compares to a deposit
Many safe-sounding tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so they can't be compared
A big percentage for stocks (24.04%) is the first number you see, which is frightening and misleading
The dark background, thin text and dense table of numbers are tiring to read
The colored circles for exposure are too close in color and too small to tell apart
Jargon and English letters with no plain explanation
The site name 'מקור' is unknown, and nothing shows it is official
The return column doesn't say whether '3 שנים' is per year or total
Long list, with 15 screens to scroll
